title: The Pokémon World Tournament's Trainers: res/trainers/facilities/pwt_trainers.json
description: ARCID_WBT_TOOL (a/2/4/7): a WbtTrainer (field/wbt.h) for each Trainer of the tournaments, which WbtTrainers_Load (wbt_tool.c) reads and wbt_makematch.c and wbt_battle.c use. tools/data/pwt_trainer_data.py packs it.

trainer_class.description: The Trainer's class, which their entrant and battle take

tournaments.description: The tournaments of 11, 4, 10, 12, 14, 13 and 15 that the Trainer takes part in (inTournament11 and the others)

unk5_7.description: The last bit of those, WbtTrainer.unk5_7

tournament.description: The tournament that only has this Trainer, for tournaments 1 and 5 to 9

expert_type.description: The type the Type Expert Tournament picks the Trainer for, TYPE_NULL for any

rank.description: WbtTrainer.unk8_0, which WbtEntrant_Set takes as the entrant's rank

unk9.description: WbtTrainer.unk9, which the code doesn't read

bgm.description: The music of the battle against the Trainer

unkE.description: WbtTrainer.unkE, whose being set WbtEntrant_Set takes
